newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks regain most of Monday's lost ground.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks regain most of Monday's lost ground.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks powered higher on Tuesday as the bull market resumed after being derailed on Monday by the Japanese prime minister's comment on his country's U.S treasury holdings.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 153.80 points, or 2.02 percent, at 7,758.06 after Monday's 192-point drop, which was the second-steepest drop ever for the blue-chip index.
In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines by a 2-1 margin on active volume of 547 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
